addons.name: Certificate manager
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: Shows the certificate on the device and reissues the .crt and .key over SSH, with the subject, paths and follow-up commands kept in addons/_data/cert_manager/config.json.

addons.name: OpenWrt Log Viewer
addons.author: fligma
addons.description: One tab, two sub-pages: a single-device log viewer on the app's main connection, and a multi-device view that keeps its own colour-coded connections and merges every log by time. The search highlights matching lines; the behaviour, colours and fetch settings are all configurable.
